annotator_b_method: Genuine blind automated annotator: model=aws/claude-sonnet-4-5 received the NomosFlow policy specification (plain-English rules derived from policy.rego) and the event payload for each item.  Labels and class tags were withheld.  The model was asked for a binary verdict (violation | benign) with no other guidance.  This measures label-scheme interpretability from the policy text alone.  Annotator B is an automated system, not a human.
